estimator_spec: Nystroem(rbf, n_components=1024, gamma=1/median pairwise sq dist on a 2000-cell TRAIN subsample) -> the same LogisticRegression
random30: within-fold pooled cells, stratified 70/30, averaged over the 2 folds — WITHIN-DISTRIBUTION diagnostic (same-slide cells in train and test), NOT generalization. Differs from classifier_sweep_lopo.py, which pools all 12 slides; the two are NOT cross-comparable.
typing_split: WITHIN-FOLD leave-one-slide-out (trains on 5) — avoids the indirect leak described in Trap 1
slideid_split: random 70/30 over cells, 12-way, chance 0.0833, LOWER is better
